products.name: Hisense 250 Sq. Ft. No Inverter 9 Amp
products.notes:
When the compressor is actively running in Cool Mode, the unit will pull a constant maximum wattage. Because it lacks an inverter, the compressor operates at a fixed speed, cycling entirely on and off instead of adjusting its cooling capacity. The minimum safe voltage to run in cool mode is 103.5 volts.

Other things that suck:
	- Cool Mode: There's no low or medium. It always runs on high.
	- Cool Mode isn't consistent on a 100 ft 10 Gauge + 100 ft 10 Gauge + 25 ft 12 Gauge cord.
		- Sometimes it spontaneously shuts off. Daily highs are nearly 100F!
		- It's probably just gonna get worse when Phoenix AZ summer heat ramps up to 115F.
	- It only cools the area right in front of it. The rest of my RV is too hot where the vents are not aimed!
	- My RV has only 2 inch thick walls so summer heat bakes through quite easily.
		- It would be much better to have an AC unit able to cool DOUBLE the required Square Footage.
	- This is quite literally a bottom of the barrel portable AC unit which only cools "250 Sq. Ft.".
	- Sometimes this unit is LOUD! I think it's louder when too much voltage drop occurs.
		- I don't know how old it is because I inherited this unit. 
		- Aside from the ratings it's even more annoying when it switches modes on it's own.
	- It only remembers the temp I set it to for a limited time only. So annoying!

-Brian M

products.name: Midea Duo 450 Sq. Ft. With Inverter 10.5 Amp On High
products.notes:
The Midea Duo 450 sq ft portable air conditioner is rated for a standard 115-volt outlet. The inverter compressor dynamically adjusts its power draw to match your cooling needs. Setting Cool Mode or Fan Mode to low, medium, or high directly changes both the wattage and amperage.

Thanks to its variable-speed inverter technology, it can safely and efficiently operate on a minimum voltage as low as 100 volts during drops and fluctuations. If the voltage drops below 100 volts, the unit's printed circuit board (PCB) will trigger an automatic shutdown to protect its internal compressor and electronics. It will then resume normal operation once the voltage returns to the safe 100 V to 150 V range.

Cool Mode Consumption (approximate real-world ranges):
	- High: 1,100 ~> 1,200 W, 9.2 ~> 10.5 A
	- Medium: 600 ~> 800 W, 5.0 ~> 6.7 A
	- Low: 250 ~> 450 W, 2.1 ~> 3.8 A

-Brian M
